name: Pi.dev Review: The Pi Coding Agent Tested Hands-On - Petronella Cybersecurity News
description: The domain pi.dev, according to the official site's homepage and its own tag, hosts a "terminal-based coding agent" published by developer Mario Zechner under the npm package @mariozechner/pi-coding-agent. The project source lives at github.com/badlogic/pi-mono/tree/main/packages/coding-agent, is MIT licensed, and the domain was, per the project's own README, donated to the project by exe.dev.
